purpose: Increase qualified organic discovery, repeat exploration, deep-link sharing and useful downstream planning intent from the production-reconciled ERN catalog.

workstreams.action: Notify IndexNow after successful production deploys using only the recently updated crawlable destination feed plus core discovery URLs. Keep Google on sitemap/Search Console; do not treat submission as guaranteed indexing.
workstreams.successSignal: Faster Bing/participating-engine discovery of genuinely updated ERN destination pages.

workstreams.action: Maintain the 751-place production-reconciled discovery universe with crawlable destination pages, aliases, geography, source type, currentness, related ERN places and useful planning context. Improve depth and freshness before adding count.
workstreams.successSignal: More non-owner organic/AI landings that continue into additional ERN places.

workstreams.action: Publish substantial crawlable country hubs only where ERN has at least six current or schedule-verified destinations. Link destination pages back to the country hub and keep payment irrelevant to inclusion.
workstreams.successSignal: More qualified country-level search/social landings that continue into multiple ERN destination pages.

workstreams.action: Publish a bounded Atom feed of recently updated crawlable destination pages and advertise it from robots.txt and the homepage. Keep source-derived last-modified dates authoritative.
workstreams.successSignal: Search/feed crawlers can discover meaningful recent destination changes without repeated full-site rediscovery.

workstreams.action: Use the 751-place catalog to deepen long-tail search and AI discovery across countries, islands, cities, mountains, parks, wildlife and current-condition queries. Add new places only for demonstrated geographic/provider/visitor utility gaps.
workstreams.successSignal: Broader search-query coverage across place names, islands, mountains, parks and current-condition searches.

workstreams.action: Make each crawlable destination page directly shareable with canonical destination-specific URLs, clear current-source status and useful related/country routes.
workstreams.successSignal: More referral landings on destination pages and more multi-place exploration after a shared entry.

workstreams.action: Keep travel options downstream from a viewed/searched place and measure aggregate travel_option_opened by destination/intent.
workstreams.successSignal: Sustained qualified outbound planning clicks across multiple destinations.

workstreams.action: Use related destinations, Browse All, geography/category discovery and Wander to move visitors beyond the landing page.
workstreams.successSignal: More place opens per visitor and lower single-page abandonment.

workstreams.action: Use currently link-generation-capable utilities such as Airalo, Go City, Kiwitaxi, Radical Storage, Aviasales and KKday only where they solve a clear visitor need.
workstreams.successSignal: First genuine non-owner utility clicks/conversions without cluttering ERN.

workstreams.action: Recheck traffic-gated Travelpayouts programs only after a platform status change, first affiliate conversion, sustained qualified outbound activity, or material organic traffic growth.
workstreams.successSignal: A previously locked program exposes usable/approved link-generation controls.

workstreams.action: Favor destination and country deep links in manual organic sharing rather than repeatedly sharing only the homepage, so social visitors land on a specific useful Earth view and can continue through related places.
workstreams.successSignal: Referral traffic spreads across destination pages and generates more multi-place exploration.

workstreams.action: Count only successful native-share or copy-link actions from both crawlable destination pages and the main ERN viewer. Use aggregate destination/share data to learn which Earth views visitors naturally pass along; never infer private social reach.
workstreams.successSignal: Reliable aggregate share/copy counts across destination-page and in-app viewing surfaces.

workstreams.action: Preserve raw privacy-safe zero-result counts, but group repeated spellings/languages into destination research clusters and separate genuine destination demand from progressive typing fragments, venue/utility intent, low-confidence partials and terms that now resolve. Only research-qualified destination clusters may open source-research lanes.
workstreams.successSignal: Destination clusters shrink when ERN truthfully resolves demand (for example Phuket), while raw historical search evidence remains intact and typing/venue noise does not inflate the source backlog.

workstreams.action: Treat Home + Watch Earth opening quality as traffic retention infrastructure: prioritize truthful source-backed imagery, provider/geographic variety and fast continuation into another place.
workstreams.successSignal: Referral and search visitors open more than one place and fewer first impressions depend on illustrative fallback.

workstreams.action: Promote sharing of destination-specific URLs from the viewer and crawlable destination pages, then use aggregate successful share/copy events only as a directional signal. Never infer private social reach.
workstreams.successSignal: Clean v2 destination share/copy events become non-zero and referral landings distribute across place pages instead of only the homepage.

workstreams.action: Use Taitung Jinzun as the quality benchmark: a strong truthful Earth source, clear source status, useful related-place continuation and optional downstream planning only while playback/currentness gates are satisfied.
workstreams.successSignal: More high-value destinations reach the same source-truth + continuation + planning quality without commercial influence on ranking.

workstreams.action: Prefer new places backed by strong first-party/public-authority current sources over repeated research on stubborn unresolved gaps. Current batch adds five official Tokyo island live destinations and a dedicated crawlable collection.
workstreams.successSignal: More qualified global discovery landings and place/source opens from strong new destinations without lowering source standards.

workstreams.action: Use the 147 current place-alias groups for truthful multilingual Search/Explore retrieval, including Tokyo islands, Chile/Patagonia, Oceania, South Africa and national park/Antarctica cameras. Before declaring traffic impact, verify actual earthrightnow.app searches and measure settled queries that become successful destination opens; aliases do not increase the number of places.
workstreams.successSignal: Verified Japanese, Spanish and romanized searches open their intended existing destinations with no source/ranking/permission changes.
workstreams.deploymentEvidence: Pages #2939 green in owner screenshot on 2026-10-08; same-content-SHA Operations + Syntax and independent domain test still not confirmed.

note: ERN now has 758 healthy searchable places. Growth prioritizes strong-source global expansion, first-impression quality, deep destination entry, repeat exploration and explicit downstream planning. Stubborn unresolved gaps move to event-driven hold instead of consuming repeated cycles.

latestObservedTraffic.interpretationBoundary: Aggregate privacy-preserving evidence only. Traffic metric semantics v2 is active. Destination ranking uses clean v2 place-open attribution. No counts identify individual visitors or prove channel causation, bookings, conversions or revenue. Share actions remain zero.
latestObservedTraffic.topPlacesInterpretation: Clean v2 destination-open attribution is active and now has a broader observed sample. Keep this ranking separate from older legacy place counters.

currentGapSummary.note: This batch adds destination clustering, reclassifies unresolved <=4-character single-token fragments more cautiously, and adds a first-party Phuket source. The next successful Operations packet is authoritative for the new cluster count.

seoGrowth.primaryGoal: Increase qualified organic landings on useful destination and editorial discovery pages, then lead visitors into additional truthful ERN exploration.
currentActions: Keep only current/schedule-verified destination pages indexable; stale/recheck pages remain noindex,follow.
Expand crawlable editorial collections only where ERN has substantial useful coverage; current batch adds Volcanoes & Earth Science and Parks & Protected Places.
Use internal links from collections, countries and related-place sections into destination pages; commercial value never changes those links.
Expose accurate lastmod values, sitemap entries, breadcrumbs, Place/CollectionPage/ItemList structured data and the recent-updates Atom feed.
Allow large image/snippet/video previews on generated indexable discovery pages to improve search-result presentation where engines choose to use them.
Preserve multilingual Discover hreflang coverage with human-written collection labels rather than automatic translation.

Continue Google Search Console + sitemap observation as the authoritative Google indexing feedback loop; IndexNow remains supplemental discovery submission and is never treated as proof of Google indexing.
Use the demand-led Thailand Live & Current Views collection as a truthful crawlable entry path while keeping the six-place country-hub threshold unchanged.
Use research-qualified destination gaps rather than raw zero-result count alone; exclude progressive typing fragments and non-destination/venue intent from automatic SEO/source expansion decisions.

Publish the substantial Lakes, Waterfalls & Fjords collection in all seven existing ERN languages, using current/schedule-verified rows only, reciprocal language links, crawlable destination links and source-derived sitemap dates. Treat it as an organic discovery improvement, never as proof of new visits.
avoid: Do not mass-produce thin city pages from keywords.
Do not create pages for one-off zero-result queries without a truthful current ERN source.
Do not change dates merely to simulate freshness.
Do not inflate page copy for word-count targets.
Do not let affiliate offers determine crawlability, internal-link prominence or collection membership.
seoGrowth.nextEvidence: Watch Search Console impressions/clicks and ERN clean-v2 referral/destination landings after the Thailand collection and other current discovery pages are deployed and crawled; expand only from real query/landing evidence.
